Liverpool transfer news: Sidy Barhama Ndiaye agrees deal to sign for Reds - Paper Talk
Plus: Premier League officials are 'shocked and furious' after the FA overturned Man Utd defender Leny Yoro's red card; Viktor Gyokeres has insisted he is fully committed to Arsenal; Conor Coady has emerged as one of the candidates to become new head coach at Blackpool
Wednesday 25 November 2026 21:55, UK
The top stories and transfer rumours from Thursday's newspapers...
Premier League
Liverpool have agreed a deal to sign highly-rated Senegalese wonderkid Sidy Barhama Ndiaye - The Sun
Premier League officials are 'shocked and furious' after the FA overturned Manchester United defender Leny Yoro's red card at Liverpool - despite the competition's own independent panel unanimously backing the dismissal - Daily Mail
Former Manchester United star Alejandro Garnacho appears to have thrown another social media strop after deleting all trace of Aston Villa on his Instagram - The Sun
Viktor Gyokeres has insisted he is fully committed to Arsenal - and warned they will take their goal frustrations out on someone - Mirror
Rasmus Hojlund has laid bare the suffocating pressure of playing for Manchester United and given his insight into what Mauricio Pochettino's squad will be suffering while marooned in the Premier League relegation zone - Daily Mail

Other football
Conor Coady has emerged as one of the candidates to become new head coach at Blackpool - Daily Mail
Keylor Navas has set his sights on conquering another sport after launching his own MMA promotion - The Sun
Scottish football
Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain has admitted he still feels like a 17-year-old each day as he bids to prove himself with Celtic - The Scottish Sun
Besiktas have slapped an incredible £25m price tag on the head of former Celtic striker Hyeon-gyu Oh, with Spartak Moscow set to make their move - The Scottish Sun
Dundee United boss Jim Goodwin insists star man Zidane Iqbal will be going nowhere in January - The Scottish Sun
Aberdeen has agreed a long-term deal with rising young star Andrew Fasanya - Daily Record
Rugby
South Africa have boycotted the Nations Championship finals media launch by refusing to send a coach alongside Siya Kolisi, their captain - Telegraph
The Rugby Football Union's head groundsman is confident Twickenham's pitch will hold up to staging six matches across three days for the Nations Championship finals, detailing the lengths to which he and his support staff will go - Guardian
Swimming
Two-time Olympic swimming champion Duncan Scott has praised the launch of a new international competition format as it looks to shake up the sport ahead of the Los Angeles Olympics in 2028 - Daily Mail
